 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `demand.multiplier` | Demand.multiplier | Scale the offered demand by `value`. |
 | `weather.front` | Weather.front | A weather front arrives: `value` is a `WeatherKind`. |
 | `attack.wave` | Attack.wave | An attack wave starts: `ids` names the attacker populations. |
 | `outage` | Outage | An entity goes down: `target` names it. |
